name: google-workspace-gog
description: Google Workspace cez gog: usage skill for Gmail, Calendar, Drive and Docs through the local gog CLI. Read-only by default, drafts only, no MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Skill · local gog CLI · no MCP
interface.longDescription: Uses the gog command line tool (gogcli) installed by the user, signed in with the user's own Google Cloud OAuth client. Read-only by default; emails only as drafts; every change is shown with --dry-run and runs only after explicit confirmation. Omni Legal Products ships no OAuth client and no server.
defaultPrompt: Nájdi v Gmaile posledné správy od klienta a zhrň ich; nič neodosielaj.
